title: Storage and command line
author: claude
summary: Each entry is one file, and a small command adds entries without the dev server.
what: Each entry is one file, `devlog/entries/<id>.json`, and its images go in `devlog/images/<id>/`. A small tool (`npm run log`) adds entries from the command line, without the dev server.
why: Plain files are easy to read, search and keep in git, and Claude can write them directly.
how:
- One plain Node file (`store.mjs`) checks, saves, lists and deletes entries.
- Another (`ids.mjs`) makes ids.
- Both the command line and the dev server use them, so entries are written the same way everywhere.
- The command line also takes `--json`, `--update` and `--meta`.
wrong: The first ids were cut in the middle of words.
fix: Ids are now cut at a word boundary.

tech.name: Node.js
tech.plain: Runs small command-line programs, such as the dev log tool.
